purpose: Registry of accepted, repeatable pre-existing verification failures. This is not a waiver for new failures.

policy.empty_means: No accepted pre-existing failures are currently registered.
add_only_when: The failure existed before the current change.
The failure has a stable suite and signature.
The owner or project workflow explicitly accepts carrying it as known debt.
The entry has a review date, expiry date, and tracking issue.
policy.never_use_for: Do not add a newly introduced failure to make a change appear green. Expired or malformed active entries are invalid.
